title: ESC during a node-press (drag active): the release ignores press_swallowed and re-selects the deselected node, and a snapped draw still commits after ESC
detail: ESC sets press_swallowed so the in-flight click's release 'must not re-select', but the drag-release branch (press on a node → drag.active) never checks press_swallowed: the release re-selects the node ESC just deselected, and a snapped drag_to still commits the draw.
recommended_fix: Gate the drag-release click-select (and commit) on !app.press_swallowed, or clear drag.active/drag_to in the ESC deselect branch — matching the plain-release branch at app/main.odin:524.

title: Placement commit lacks the release_ui_hit guard: a press in the 6px band below/beside a tray chip with release on the chip places a router on the tile behind the tray
detail: Click-select releases are gated on release_ui_hit (tray chip = UI, never a world click), but the placement commit only checks press_swallowed: press just outside a chip edge, release on it → places a router on the tile under the tray.
recommended_fix: Add !release_ui_hit(app, mouse) to the placement commit condition at app/main.odin:510, consistent with the click-select releases; or reject placement tiles that sit under the tray band.
